_comment: Per-project legal copy. Copy to config.<projectName>.json and edit. These templates ship NO product description of their own — an earlier version hardcoded one project's wedding-image-generator prose into every project's Terms of Service, which is a legally-operative document describing the wrong product. If a project supplies no config, setup halts rather than inventing terms.
productSummary: One or two sentences describing what the service actually does, in plain language.
dataItems: Account data — your email address and sign-in details.
Support messages — anything you send us by email or through our forms.
Privacy-respecting analytics — aggregate usage via a self-hosted analytics tool; no third-party ad trackers.
pricingClause: Describe the commercial model, or state plainly that the service is not yet sold. Do NOT invent a price.
licenseClause: Describe what rights the user has in what they create or receive.
refundSummary: One sentence describing the refund posture, or that nothing is sold yet.
sensitiveDataNote: Optional. If the product handles microphones, cameras, screen capture, location, health or financial data, say so here explicitly — this text is rendered prominently in the privacy policy.
_comment_sellsProduct: Set true once the product is actually sold. Gates the Merchant-of-Record and refund-window assertions in verify.mjs, so the gate and the pages cannot disagree.
